$comment: THE LOCKDOWN ALLOWLIST (ADR-0050). Every Ansible module, lookup plugin and action plugin the
scp-runner-ops image is permitted to contain. The Dockerfile DELETES everything not named here;
`lockdown.test.ts` asserts the set present in the built image equals this file exactly, in both
directions.
DERIVED FROM CHARTER TEXT, not from convenience. The Managed Execution Exception's 2026-07-12
host-reaching amendment enumerates exactly three classes, and each entry below belongs to one of
them or to the minimum needed to run a play at all. Adding an entry because a role wants it is
either within those three classes or it is a charter question — the set-equality gate exists to
force that conversation rather than let it happen in a Dockerfile diff.
WHAT IS ABSENT AND WHY IT MATTERS: command, shell, raw, script, expect, pip, git, subversion and
async_wrapper all reach code execution. include_vars/include_role/include_tasks/import_role/
import_tasks/import_playbook turn data into TASKS, which defeats 'no shell module reachable'
without touching a shell module. uri/get_url/fetch/slurp/unarchive reach the network or move
arbitrary bytes. The `pipe` and `lines` LOOKUPS execute commands during template rendering, which
is the SSTI->RCE path the whole lockdown exists to close.
Pure data transforms for loops, plus first_found. NOTHING that executes, reads the filesystem
by tenant-influenced path, or reaches the network. first_found is included because OS-family
template selection genuinely needs it and its search paths come from the signed role, never
from a tenant parameter.
Action plugins are the client-side half of a module. `normal` is the default dispatcher and is
REQUIRED — without it no module runs at all. The rest pair with an allowed module.
